body.message: celld egress policy: 127.0.0.1:${UPSTREAM_PORT} is not a public address, so this node refuses to connect to it. A node operator can allow it by adding 127.0.0.1:${UPSTREAM_PORT} to CELLD_FETCH_PRIVATE_ALLOW.

celld egress policy: [::1]:${UPSTREAM_PORT_2} is not a public address, so this node refuses to connect to it. A node operator can allow it by adding [::1]:${UPSTREAM_PORT_2} to CELLD_FETCH_PRIVATE_ALLOW.
